people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
translations.bsb: Later, as Jesus was dining at Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with Him and His disciples.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
